title: print page: a collapsible `record:details` section still draws its disclosure chevron and clickable-header chrome on paper — card ② opens the section but keeps the screen control
body:
Filing gate ①: a class-a finding from the os-dev report on objectui#12717 (comment `6219124800`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

reach: the print render path, by static read only (NOT MEASURED on paper). The print chain is under the maintainer's rule 「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」, as triage quoted it on objectui#12717.

## Measured (static, PR #12729 head `9f28cd2`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` renders a collapsible section's header as a button with a disclosure chevron (`ChevronDown`, around `:879`–`:883`), and the header carries `cursor-pointer` and hover classes.
- On a print page, card ② (objectui#11958) opens the section (`usePrintPage() === null && collapsedState`), but the chevron and the button chrome still draw. Paper therefore carries a screen-only disclosure control, the same defect class as #12717's "Show N empty fields" button.
- objectui#12717's PR #12729 read `usePrintPage()` once, above every early return (`isPrintPage`), so the fix can reuse that value.
- Noted, not part of this card: the hover copy and pencil buttons (`:665`, `:687`) stay `opacity-0` until hover, so they draw nothing on paper.

## Acceptance (proposed)

1. On a page that declares `print`, a collapsible section's header prints as a plain heading, with no chevron and no button chrome.
2. Off a print page, the collapsible header is unchanged.
3. Pins inside and outside a `PrintPageProvider`, each proven red by ablation.

**Serial note:** this is the same file as objectui#12717 (PR #12729, in flight) and objectui#12618 (`pm:on-hold`). Take it after #12729 lands.

Dedupe: `search_issues` in objectui with "print page collapsible section chevron disclosure icon record details header button on paper" returned 9 results. The nearest are #12717 (the toggle, not the chevron), #11958 (closed, card ② itself) and #12618 (the on-screen fold). None covers the chevron on paper.
